🎤 Song Lyrics: Usher - Burn

[Intro]
Girl, I understand why
See, it's burnin' me to hold on to this
I know this is somethin' I gotta do
But that don't mean I want to
What I'm tryna say is that, I... love you, I just...
I feel like this... is comin' to an end
And it's better for me to... let it go now
Than hold on and hurt you
But I gotta let it burn

[Verse 1]
It's gon' burn for me to say this, but it's comin' from my heart
It's been a long time comin', but we done been fell apart
Really wanna work this out, but I don't think you're gonna change
I do, but you don't, think it's best we go our separate ways
Tell me why I should stay in this relationship
When I'm hurtin', baby, I ain't happy, baby
Plus there's so many other things I gotta deal with
I think that you should let it burn

But you know, gotta let it go 'cause the party ain't
Jumpin' like it used to, even though this might bruise you (No, no)
Let it burn (Yeah), let it burn (Ooh), gotta let it burn
Deep down, you know it's best for yourself, but you
Hate the thought of her bein' with someone else
But you know that it's over, we knew it was through (Yeah)
Let it burn (Let it burn, woah), let it burn (Let it burn), gotta let it burn

[Verse 2]
Sendin' pages I ain't supposed to
Got somebody here, but I want you

Ladies, tell me, do you understand?
Now, all my fellas, do you feel my pain?
It's the way I feel
I know I made a mistake, now, it's too late
I know she ain't comin' back
What I gotta do now (Now) to get my shorty back?
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Man, I don't know what I'm gonna do without my boo
You've been gone for too long
It's been fifty-leven days, umpteen hours
I'ma be burnin' 'til you return (Let it burn)

[Chorus]
When your feelin' ain't the same and your body don't want to (Oh)
But you know, gotta let it go 'cause the party ain't (Cause the party ain't)
Jumpin' like it used to, even though this might bruise you
Let it burn (Let it burn, let it burn, you gon' learn)
Let it burn (Gotta let it burn, oh), gotta let it burn (Oh)
Deep down, you know it's best for yourself, but you
Hate the thought of her bein' with someone else
But you know that it's over (Know it's over), we knew it was through (Know it's through)
Let it burn, let it burn, gotta let it burn (Ooh, girl, I)

[Bridge]
I'm twisted 'cause one side of me is tellin' me that I need to move on
On the other side, I wanna break down and cry, ooh
I'm twisted 'cause one side of me is tellin' me that I need to move on
On the other side, I wanna break down and cry, yeah
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
Ooh, ooh, ooh (Can you feel me burnin'?)
Ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh, ooh
So many days, so many hours
I'm still burnin' 'til you return (Let it burn)

[Chorus]
When your feelin' ain't the same and your body don't want to
But you know, gotta let it go 'cause the party ain't
Jumpin' like it used to, even though this might bruise you
Let it burn (Let it burn, let it burn), let it burn, gotta let it burn
Ooh, deep down, you know it's best for yourself, but you
Hate the thought of her bein' with someone else
But you know that it's over, we knew it was through
Let it burn (Let it burn, let it burn, let it burn)
Let it burn, gotta let it burn

FAQ: 

When does Last Seen premiere? 
Last Seen premieres September 9, 2026 on Apple TV.

Where can I watch Last Seen?
Watch Last Seen on Apple TV.

Who stars in Last Seen?
Last Seen features Gotham Award winner Patrick Brammall, Maxine Peake, Brendan Cowell, Daniel Henshall, Jessica Wren, Zahra Newman and newcomer Chloe Jean Lourdes.

What is Last Seen about? 
Last Seen is about a former police detective Ian Ridley’s life and how it fell apart 11 years ago when his young daughter, Maggie, disappeared without a trace. Now working as a police dispatcher, the only thing that has kept him going is his implacable refusal to accept that she might be gone forever. When he receives a distress call from a teenage girl he is certain is Maggie, he will stop at nothing to find her and reunite his broken family, whatever the cost.

What genre is Last Seen?
Last Seen is a six-episode Australian thriller.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community.  Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Nyancho - DUWULO  - (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
DUWOLU – Official Music Video by Nyancho

“Duwolu”, a Mandinka word meaning (Vultures) is the latest powerful social commentary from Gambian artist Nyancho.
Following the message of Wulolu, Duwolu continues Nyancho’s call for unity, peace, justice, accountability, and a better future for The Gambia. The song gives a voice to the frustrations and struggles experienced by ordinary Gambians, particularly young people and those whose voices are often unheard.
The message of Duwolu is not intended as an accusation against the Government or any individual. Rather, it is an appeal and a reminder that many ordinary citizens are struggling and deserve better opportunities, security, justice, and dignity.
Over the years, Gambians have witnessed public discussions and allegations surrounding corruption, misuse of public resources, unexplained wealth, and the disappearance or mismanagement of public funds. We have also seen questions raised about how some individuals who lived modestly for many years later acquired significant wealth, expensive vehicles, and large properties after entering positions of influence.

There have also been concerns about public officials who have spoken against corruption or challenged wrongdoing and subsequently lost their positions. Whether through political disagreements, institutional decisions, or other circumstances, these situations have raised important questions about accountability and transparency.

At the same time, our communities continue to face serious challenges. Innocent people have lost their lives to crime, while many families continue to seek answers and justice. Tribal and divisive rhetoric has also become a concern, with words that can create tension and threaten the unity that Gambians have worked hard to preserve.

And perhaps most importantly, our young people are struggling.
Youth unemployment remains a major challenge. Many young Gambians see irregular migration as their only path toward a better life, risking their lives on dangerous journeys instead of finding opportunities at home. Every young person who leaves represents not only a personal loss, but potentially the loss of a future leader, entrepreneur, artist, professional, or community builder.
Duwolu is therefore a reflection of what many Gambians are feeling and experiencing.
It is a call for those in positions of power to listen to the people.
A call for accountability.
A call for justice.
A call for unity.
A call for peace.
And above all, a call to build a Gambia where every citizen has a fair opportunity to live with dignity and hope.
This song is not about attacking anyone.
It is about asking difficult questions.
It is about speaking for those who may not have a platform.
It is about reminding ourselves that The Gambia belongs to all of us.

🎵 Duwolu – https://audiomack.com/nyanchoapchaky/song/duwolu?share-user-id=37612655

Watch, listen, share, and join the conversation.
Peace. Unity. Justice. Accountability.

#Nyancho #Duwolu #DuwoluOfficialVideo #TheGambia #GambianMusic #MandinkaMusic #GambianMusicIndustry #Unity #Peace #Justice #Accountability #Youth #Gambia

We are testing whether or not the Neighbor is up to the task and can handle the stress of running an entire hotel by himself. We will add some chaos, break some stuff, and see what happens when he reacts! Join me on this amazing and hilarious adventure as we discover what happens when we make his HOUSE INTO A HOTEL!!! snippet.title: The Lord of the Rings War in the North Legacy Edition Gameplay Walkthrough Part 1 (Remastered PS5)
snippet.description:
The Lord of the Rings War in the North Legacy Edition releases on PS5, Switch 1 & 2, PC & Xbox - Thanks to Aspyr for the Review Code
Choose Your Orc-Bane: Seamlessly swap between three uniquely skilled characters with Eradan, the stealthy Dúnadan Ranger, Andriel, the magical Elven Loremaster, and Farin, the tank-like Dwarven Champion.
Build a Fellowship in Co-Op: Play in a group of up to three players online or two players in local split-screen*, working together with your friends as you fight for the survival of your Fellowship and all of Middle-earth! 
Deep RPG Progression: Customize your hero and party members with unique skills, abilities, and gear to complement your playstyle. Collect powerful weapons and armor, and even command the mighty Great Eagle Beleram to strike from the sky and turn the tide of battle.
Iconic Cameos & Locations: Encounter familiar faces like Aragorn, Gandalf, and Elrond as you journey through lore-rich locations such as the Elven sanctuaries of Rivendell and Lórien and the foggy paths of Mirkwood.
A Darker Middle-earth Full of Peril: Experience a mature story featuring brutal warfare and blood-soaked battlefields in a world gnawed by ruthless Orcs, deadly Wargs, spectral Barrow-wights, and the dark sorcery of Agandaûr’s forces.
Character Hot-Swapping: New in this edition, swap between characters on-the-fly, adding the ability to fully assign equipment, skills, and abilities for Computer controlled allies for the first time. 
Additions and Enhancements for Modern Consoles: Enjoy modernizations like 60 FPS support* Triggering Secrets (see other character’s secrets no matter who you’re playing as), the ability to lock-on enemies, and UI/UX optimizations such as visible Health, Mana, and EXP bars, autosaves and additional save slots, and gyro/motion sensor support on PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch 1 & 2, along with bug fixes.
